additionalFields.description: This is a disposable setup test created by n8n on the OpportunityOS demo calendar. No opportunity was processed and no application was submitted. Delete this event after confirming it appears.

nodes.name: Confirm Google returned the saved event

parameters.jsCode: const event = $input.first().json; if (event.id !== '0000000ca1e0da0001' || event.status === 'cancelled') throw new Error('Calendar test did not return the expected saved event'); return [{json:{verified:true,message:'Calendar write verified',event_id:event.id,start:event.start,end:event.end,calendar_link:event.htmlLink}}];

parameters.content:
## Slice 0 Calendar write check
Select OpportunityOS Calendar credentials AND the separate demo calendar you created. The calendar selector is intentionally empty. Execute once; the test creates a private event tomorrow, 10:00-10:15 IST, with no attendees or reminders. The fixed event ID prevents duplicate events: rerunning may return 409 Already exists. Verify it in Google Calendar and delete it manually afterward. No AI or database calls. Do not publish this test.
